source_title: Factory raises $150M Series C
claim_summary: Company reports a $150M Series C at a $1.5B valuation led by Khosla Ventures; law-firm client note gives the same figures and date.
limitation: Funding is not adoption, task value or product quality; terms are company/counsel statements without filing-level verification.

source_title: droid-action v5
claim_summary: GitHub release v5 adds a review_depth input with shallow and deep presets for Droid PR review.
availability: public GitHub release; GitHub API detects no licence file for the repository
limitation: Release notes are vendor-authored; review quality of presets not tested; licence of the action not established.

claim_summary: Changelog v0.106.0 lists a full-project security audit mode in security-review.
limitation: One changelog page holds many dated entries; detection recall/precision not measured.

source_title: Automated QA: Testing Your App the Way a Real User Would
claim_summary: Factory described automatic browser/terminal/API QA with visual evidence attached to pull requests.
availability: vendor-described feature and PR report; not independently exercised
limitation: Visual proof can still miss unsupported paths and wrong oracles.

source_title: ExternalSecrets vulnerable to privilege escalation with secret overwriting (CVE-2026-42876)
claim_summary: Third-party advisory: a user able to create ExternalSecret resources could make the operator create a Secret populated with a long-lived service-account token. Factory's Jun 11 post lists this CVE as surfaced by its automated reviews.
availability: advisory published; affects external-secrets, not Factory software
limitation: Factory's role as finder is a vendor claim; reporter credits not checked to identity level; not evidence of Droid detection rate.

claim_summary: Changelog v0.126.0 lists EU data residency, a built-in security review and bulk archiving.
availability: changelog-listed release; plan scope not stated in summary
limitation: Residency claim not audited; contractual/DPA scope unknown.

source_title: Factory Router
claim_summary: Factory introduced model routing with vendor-reported token reductions.
availability: private research preview; no external effectiveness test
limitation: Vendor comparison is not a measured CO2e benefit or neutral task-quality result.

source_title: Introducing Automated Security Review
claim_summary: Factory launches STRIDE-based security review on non-draft PRs with inline CWE-tagged findings, stated as available on all plans; cites CVE-2026-42876 as a public finding.
limitation: No independent false-positive/negative rate; one cited CVE is not a detection-rate estimate.

claim_summary: Changelog v0.147.0 lists a command blocklist that hard-stops listed commands.
limitation: Blocklists are bypassable by equivalent commands; enforcement not tested.

source_title: Factory 2.0: From coding agents to software factories
claim_summary: Company announces wider software-factory workflow vision; distinction between announcement and fully shipped capability is essential
limitation: No independently reproduced task outcomes; reported launch scope, price/license/API and event date may differ from publication date; original first-party source not independently tested

source_title: AutoWiki
claim_summary: Factory announced source-driven incrementally refreshed repository documentation with CI integration.
limitation: Automatically regenerated text may hallucinate constraints or overlook undocumented behavior.

source_title: Droid Shield 2.0: learned secret detection
claim_summary: Factory describes learned secret detection with two fine-tuned Qwen 3.6 35B A3B adapters (risk, downgrade) layered on a deterministic scanner; weights published on Hugging Face under factoryai.
availability: research preview; Hugging Face API shows no licence tag on factoryai/shield-risk-r16-c15 or shield-dg-r64-c15 (checked 2026-10-16)
limitation: Vendor benchmark only; mixed results across budgets per vendor; reuse rights of weights unclear without a licence.

claim_summary: Changelog v0.169.0 lists a whole-process command sandbox on macOS; v0.179.0 (2026-07-23) adds sandbox isolation and macOS code-injection hardening.
availability: changelog-listed release; macOS only as listed
limitation: Sandbox escape resistance not independently assessed; platform scope limited.

source_title: Factory joins the Open Secure AI Alliance
claim_summary: Factory says it joined the Open Secure AI Alliance and commits to open-weight secret detection, responsible disclosure of OSS findings and sharing models/research.
availability: commitment statement; factory.ai path redirects (307) to factory.com
limitation: Commitments are intentions; alliance membership and deliverables not independently verified.

source_title: Exclusive: Blackstone set to back AI 'droid' firm at $3.5bn valuation
claim_summary: City AM reports, citing unnamed sources, that Blackstone was weighing a round valuing Factory above $3.5bn; Factory did not respond and Blackstone declined to comment.
limitation: Anonymous-source report; the later Sep 15 company announcement states $5B, so the $3.5bn figure was not the announced outcome.

source_title: vfs v1.0.0
claim_summary: First vfs release 'under Factory's own identity': a fork of agentfs diverged after 0.6.4, with a session-handoff pipeline (seed/pack/adopt); not a drop-in upgrade from agentfs 0.6.x.
availability: public GitHub release; GitHub API detects no licence file (404 on licence endpoint, 2026-10-16)
limitation: Fork provenance and upstream licence obligations not reviewed; no licence detected means reuse rights are unclear.

source_title: droid-action v7
claim_summary: GitHub release v7 adds a CI mode for post-CI triage, retry and auto-fix (named CI Medic, renamed CI Steward in the same release).
limitation: Auto-retry/auto-fix can mask flaky tests; acceptance quality not measured.

source_title: Why model routing must be in the harness
claim_summary: Vendor describes harness-sensitive model routing and reports 58% aggregate cost reduction for selected production runs; no independent matched-task replication here
limitation: No independently reproduced task outcomes; reported launch scope, price/license/API and event date may differ from publication date; original first-party source not independently tested

source_title: Connect Droid to the tools that run your company
claim_summary: Factory launches managed Connectors (e.g. Linear, Slack, GitHub, Sentry, Notion, Salesforce) and role Personas that preselect connectors.
limitation: Broader tool access widens data/permission surface; scopes and audit not tested.

source_title: What it Takes for Coding Agents to Complete Large Software Tasks
claim_summary: Vendor compares single-agent vs multi-role (implementer/validator/orchestrator) on 24 hard ProgramBench tasks, one run per cell, reporting higher median hidden-suite scores for the multi-role system across three models.
availability: research report; post states the instrument was not archived
limitation: n=24, single run per cell, vendor-run, instrument not archived; cost/time of extra roles not established.

source_title: Factory now available on Claude Marketplace, bringing autonomous software development to the enterprise
claim_summary: Factory says enterprises can pay for Factory using existing Anthropic spend commitments via Claude Marketplace; a Sep 29 post makes a similar claim for the OpenAI marketplace.
limitation: Procurement channel is not usage or task value; counterpart listing not independently checked.

source_title: Factory raises $200M at $5B valuation
claim_summary: Company reports $200M at a $5B valuation (investors listed include Blackstone, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Insight Partners, NEA); funds for research, product and global go-to-market. TNW (Sep 17) restates the company figures without independent verification.
limitation: Company-stated terms; press coverage relies on the release; funding is not adoption or quality.

source_title: Introducing Flexible Deployment Options at Factory
claim_summary: Factory introduces Factory Managed (Factory-hosted control plane) and Factory Private (control plane and data in customer VPC, on-prem or air-gapped), the latter in Private Preview by request.
availability: Factory Private = private preview by request
limitation: No public install/security documentation reviewed; preview access gated.

source_title: Factory Router cuts inference costs by 63%
claim_summary: Vendor reports 63% aggregate inferred cost savings relative to frontier-pinned published rates, with a private-preview deployment option; claims neither full lifetime cost nor causal environmental effect
limitation: No independently reproduced task outcomes; reported launch scope, price/license/API and event date may differ from publication date; original first-party source not independently tested

source_title: Which model is best for legacy code?
claim_summary: Factory's Legacy-Bench joins Fireworks' Specialized Intelligence Index; vendor reports GPT-5.6 Sol 60.0% vs Claude Opus 5 52.0%; ten representative tasks published on GitHub in Harbor format.
availability: partial task set public (GitHub API: Factory-AI/legacy-bench, Apache-2.0)
limitation: Only 10 tasks public; full benchmark, variance and contamination controls not verifiable.

source_title: Automate the work that keeps coming back
claim_summary: Factory makes Automations (scheduled or event-triggered recurring Droid tasks) generally available for all users.
limitation: Unattended recurring agent runs raise review-load and cost questions not measured here.

source_title: Factory Analytics brings transparency to every session
claim_summary: Redesigned Analytics with Consumption, Model efficiency (Router savings) and Adoption views; available for Business and Enterprise plans.
availability: available today for Business and Enterprise (vendor)
limitation: Vendor-computed 'savings' depend on vendor baseline; per-session cost exposure not confirmed on the page.

source_title: droid-action v10
claim_summary: Release v10 fixes redaction so long-format GitHub App installation tokens (ghs_) are fully redacted in action output; prior pattern matched only 36-character tokens.
limitation: Exposure window and whether any token leaked in public logs are unknown; vendor release note only.

source_title: Factory Acquires Mentlio: Building Intelligent Token Allocation for the Software Factory
claim_summary: Factory says Mentlio (YC S26; in-harness model routing, context compression, usage-value measurement) is joining Factory; no deal terms disclosed.
limitation: Deal closing and terms unverified; acquired capability not yet a product.

source_title: Droids now have a fleet of sandboxes
claim_summary: Factory launches Environments: reusable sandbox definitions bundling repositories, tools and dependencies into prebuilt images, stated GA on all plans.
limitation: Isolation properties and image-supply-chain controls not independently checked.
